item.title: In Memoriam: Tim Peters 1952–2026 - Core Development - Discussions on Python.org
item.description: I am immensely sad to announce that Tim Peters has died earlier this year on July 15. It’s hard to overestimate Tim’s influence on Python. He’s probably best known for writing the Zen of Python (PEP 20), but to me he was a mentor and language co-designer long before that. Tim found Python not long after its initial release.
